content.short: SWC Registry is a list of Smart Contract Weakness Classification and Test Cases.
content.description: SWC Registry is a documented weakness registry overseen by the MythX team. Each entry provides a concrete test case for vulnerability simulation, helping developers write more secure smart contracts by focusing on common security flaws. In addition to the registry, the project maintains a Discord community for security consultants and a GitHub repository with hundreds of forks and stars, reflecting broad participation from the security research and development community.
